items.title: Keying requirement omits iambic paddles
items.description: REQ-SYS-014 requires only straight-key operation. Stakeholder input SI-018 states as a core requirement that the radio shall support both a straight key and iambic paddles with a built-in electronic keyer. The L1 set is therefore incomplete against its source.
items.requested_action: Add an L1 requirement for iambic paddle operation with an electronic keyer (mode, speed range with units, weighting), trace it to SI-018, assign a verification method, and allocate it to CTL and SW.
items.response: Added REQ-SYS-015 (iambic keyer, modes A and B, 5 to 50 WPM per SI-033, source SI-018, method Demonstration) and REQ-SYS-016 (key input auto-detect between straight key and paddle, method Test). Allocated both to CTL and SW in docs/design/allocation.json. Traceability report passes.

verification.note: Both requirements pass the SE HB App. C checklist; units and tolerances present; SI-018 traced.

history.note: Raised during SRR session 1, agenda item 3.

items.title: Stuck-key scenario lacks operator indication
items.description: OPS-007 (stuck key or paddle contact) describes the automatic transmit cutoff but does not say how the operator is told why the radio stopped transmitting.
items.response: OPS-007 now states that the LCD shows KEY STUCK and the sidetone changes to a fault tone until the key is released; linked to REQ-SYS-021.

history.note: Accepted as lien in the SRR decision memo; due before PDR readiness declaration.

items.title: Confirm 5 W PA feasibility on battery
items.description: Show that a 5 W CW PA at 144 MHz can be run from the proposed 2S 18650 pack (SI-023) within the thermal envelope of the aluminum enclosure, or state the constraint that changes the L1 power requirement.
items.requested_action: Analysis with a power and thermal budget at the ConOps duty cycle; state the margin.
items.response: Analysis shows a boost converter to 12 V with 55 percent overall efficiency at 5 W output, 35 percent key-down duty cycle, enclosure surface rise 18 K above ambient at 25 C, margin 22 K to the 65 K limit. L1 power requirement unchanged; RSK-003 likelihood lowered.

items.title: Keyer ergonomics in HSI section
items.description: Extend the HSI section with the paddle and straight-key jack placement, cable strain relief, and the keyer speed control access while the radio is held in one hand.
items.requested_action: Update the HSI section and add an OPS scenario for one-handed operation.

history.note: Accepted as lien in the SRR decision memo.

items.title: Duplicate of RID-SRR-001
items.description: REQ-SYS-008 key input description also lacks the paddle case; raised separately before RID-SRR-001 was written up.
items.withdrawal_reason: Duplicate; covered by RID-SRR-001 and its new requirements REQ-SYS-015 and REQ-SYS-016.
